_comment: Client chrome for app/import-records.tsx. Registered at runtime by lib/api/importRecordsQueries.ts with deep=true, overwrite=false. 1:1 with importRecords.fr.json. Skip reasons arrive translated from the server (lang/{en,fr}/patient_import.php).

importRecords.title: Import records
importRecords.subtitle: Bring records from another provider into your OpesCare record
importRecords.unverifiedBody: Imported items are kept in your record as provided by you. They are not checked by an OpesCare clinician and are always labelled as unverified.
importRecords.fhirBody: A health record file from another hospital or app. Observations, conditions, allergies, medications, immunizations, reports and documents are imported.
importRecords.documentBody: A lab report, discharge letter or prescription as PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP.
importRecords.limits: Up to 10 MB per file. Importing the same file again does not create duplicates.
importRecords.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
importRecords.exportLinkBody: Download a copy of your OpesCare record
